_about: Neutral questions for the rules ledger. Each rule lists the parameter names an answer must fill, so two independent answers can be compared by script. A value is always a short string; use 'not stated' when the sources do not say. Nothing here states an expected answer.

rules.question: When a move's knockdown advantage is listed as +N, how many frames pass before the knocked-down character can act, and how is a 'meaty' defined in frame terms?
What rise options does a knocked-down character have, how is each chosen, and do they differ in timing or only in position?
Which knockdowns remove the back-rise option (hard knockdown), and how do sources name the causes?
After a grounded wake-up, for how many frames can the rising character not be thrown, and at what attacker frame advantage does a throw connect or whiff?
After hitstun or blockstun ends, for how many frames can the character not be thrown, and what frame advantage does a tick throw need?

What are a normal throw's startup, active frames, recovery and total; its range; the throw-escape (tech) window; and the cases where a throw cannot be escaped or counts as a counter-hit or Punish Counter?
When a strike and a throw become active on the same frame, or two throws do, what happens?
How long is the input buffer for a reversal on wake-up and after hitstun or blockstun, and what did the 2026-03-17 and 2026-04-15 patches change about wake-up buffering?
Is a rising character forced to stand for some frames on wake-up, and for how many (grounded wake-up and after an air reset)?

How many pre-jump frames does a jump have (and which characters differ), what are their properties (throwable, able to block, hit state if struck), and how long is a full jump in frames including landing?
What are a back dash's total frames and its invulnerability or other properties, and what are a forward dash's total frames?

For Drive Parry: when does it become active, what is the Perfect Parry window, what does a Perfect Parry give the defender (advantage, scaling), can a parry stop a throw, and what happens when a parrying character is thrown?
For Drive Reversal: startup out of blockstun and on wake-up (recovery), invulnerable frames, advantage on block, Drive cost, knockdown advantage on hit, and any screen freeze.
For Drive Impact: startup, active frames, armor (how many hits, which frames), advantage on block, what happens on hit, at the wall, against a burned-out opponent, and when two Drive Impacts meet.

For Drive Rush: how many frames before an attack can come out from a Parry Drive Rush and from a Drive Rush cancel, the Drive cost of each, the frame-advantage bonus and which moves get it, and any special hit or throw properties during the rush.
What changes for a character in Burnout: blockstun, hitstun, chip damage, lost options, and stun conditions?
What frame-advantage bonuses do Counter Hit and Punish Counter give, and when does each apply?

What do sources say about safe jumps: the knockdown advantages that make a jump-in safe against reversals of a given startup, the characters that are exceptions, and what defeats a safe jump (armor, parry, others)?
After an air reset (flip-out), what are the landing properties: frames unable to be thrown, forced standing, anything else stated?
What do sources say about screen-freeze (Super and Drive) input buffers: can the opponent buffer or change inputs during the freeze, and by how many frames?
How does frame advantage change when an attack connects on a later active frame, and are there moves where it does not change?
What do sources say about chaining light normals (rapid cancel): which frames can cancel, and does a whiffed light recover faster when chained?
What do sources say about proximity guard (being put in a blocking stance near an attack): when it applies and how it affects walking backward?
What do sources say about throw loops: which characters can loop throws midscreen or in the corner, and what is said about Ryu?
What general input buffer lengths are stated (normal moves, specials, dashes), and any stated bugs or exceptions?
Is knockdown and wake-up timing the same against every character, or do sources name characters whose wake-up timing or hurtbox on wake-up differs?
